literal_meaning: সকল ভূত বা প্রাণী (all beings or creatures)
figurative_meaning_bn: বিশ্বব্রহ্মাণ্ডে যত জীব প্রাণী আছে সব প্রাণী
figurative_meaning_en: All living beings in the universe
example_sentences_in_bangla: সর্বভূতের মধ্যে শক্তির উপস্থিতি অনুভব করা যায়।
example_sentences_in_english: The presence of Shakti can be felt in all beings.
The goddess resides in all creatures.
history: References the concept from Devi Mahatmya where the goddess is described as residing in all beings as Shakti.
note: This phrase is more of a religious or philosophical term than a colloquial idiom, derived from Sanskrit texts integral to Bengali Hindu culture.
